messages:
Sam: Heads-up — Eclipse Labs just told AE team they need an internal governance review by next Tue. Board-level signoff required for any vendor with access to embeddings.
Sam: Main blockers: 1) they want Private (VPC) deployment + contract language for data residency, 2) security questionnaire has 30+ askes around KMS/HSM and key custody, 3) pricing cap request for Dedicated pool (they want a hard monthly cap).
Anya: Ok — for the POC environment we can spin a VPC instance but need infra lead + quota. @Raj can we reserve 2x A100s for a week? Also: which sections in the questionnaire are blocking (app vs infra)?
Sam: Infra stuff is blocking: KMS integration, audit logs retention, and cross-region replication. App questions are lower priority. I'll drop the questionnaire spreadsheet in thread.
Maria: Legal here — please don't share the raw questionnaire with reps outside the deal team. Send to legal@redwood and cc me. We'll need customer DPA + export-control addendum. If they require standing SOC2 attestation, confirm which date range they expect.
Lee: CS note — they've asked for a timeline to show the board: POC start -> 2-week evaluation -> exec signoff. Can we commit to that schedule if infra is green?
Raj: I can carve capacity but need formal approval from infra budget. @Sam, have they accepted a cost model (reserved vs burst)? If they want a hard cap we may need a special reserved contract.
Sam: They verbally asked for reserved pricing with a hard monthly cap. I proposed a draft: reserved base + buffer credits for spikes. We should prep a pricing variant for commit + overage cap.
DeployBot: [env-provision] POC VPC request received for eclipse-labs. Ticket #INC-4729 created. ETA initial environment 48 hours if quota available.
Anya: I'll take the security questionnaire items that are infra-facing. Sam — drop the spreadsheet link and mark the rows that need architecture input. I'll annotate with recommended config (KMS via customer-owned keys, audit retention 1 year, no egress replication by default).
Maria: Once legal has the DPA template in place, send to the customer for redlines. I'll join a 30-min call with their counsel if needed.
Sam: Action items: (1) Anya to annotate security spreadsheet (owner) — due in 12h, (2) Raj to confirm capacity/quota and budget ask — due EOD, (3) Maria to prepare DPA + checklist — due tomorrow morning, (4) Lee to draft board timeline slide — due EOD.
Raj: I'll confirm capacity now, expect update within 3h.
Anya: Spreadsheet link: https://drive.internal/ephemeral/eclipse-qsa.xlsx (access: deal-team only). I'll ping when annotated. :white_check_mark:
Sam: Scheduling a sync with customer for tomorrow 10am PT — sending invite now. Please accept if you can join. Thanks all.
